question: If a selection had been made, what would it have paid?
why_blank: A payout needs a price. No price is registered, and inventing a standard -110 would be an assumption about an operator that this repository has not read.

what_is_published_instead.probabilities: in backtest.json, one per market per game
what_is_published_instead.outcomes: the official final score of every game
what_is_published_instead.what_would_be_needed: 1 registered price per selection, with the operator's void and push rules

breakeven_arithmetic.note: Printed as arithmetic only. It is not a price this project claims to have been offered.
